title: A small Banach space $C(K)$ without nice renormings
summary: We prove that consistently $ω_1<\mathfrak{c}$ and there exists a compact space $K$ whose Banach space $C(K)$ of continuous real-valued functions is Grothendieck, has density $ω_1$, and admits no renorming which is strictly convex or sequentially Kadets--Klee.
